findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: apione_email_find, apione_people_search · Private data: apione_company_enrich, apione_email_find, apione_signals, apione_name_match, apione_people_search · Public sink: apione_people_enrich, apione_email_find, apione_email_verify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: apione_email_find, apione_people_search · Private data: apione_company_enrich, apione_email_find, apione_signals, apione_name_match, apione_people_search · Public sink: apione_people_enrich, apione_email_find, apione_email_verify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
